objective: Bounded independent review of the pinned offline field-level metadata diagnostic delta, not an installer or runtime authorization.
disposition: No blocking defect found in the reviewed delta. Accept only the pinned source/test change and public expectations profile for offline diagnostic implementation. The selected test slice is not fully green; operational installation remains INCOMPLETE and outside this review.

scope.additional_check: Read-only public-profile validation and byte-for-byte reproduction; no runtime backend invocation.
excluded: Docker CLI, daemon or socket access
Installation, build, startup, cleanup or recovery actions
Legacy fixture repairs and broad repository audit
Full suite, test matrices, market data or trading actions

preserved_comparison.method: Direct diff -u against hash-verified preserved files, not git diff of untracked files.
preserved_comparison.delta: Installer adds an optional validated diagnostic failure event and paired CLI profile arguments. Backend adds an optional constructor argument and read-only diagnostic method. Existing replacement acceptance checks, rollback policy and transport implementation are unchanged.

review_checks.evidence: Expectations.load verifies byte hash, duplicate keys, exact record/field keys, application order, plan hash and all four replacement gate digests. read_profile accepts only a canonical regular JSON path below docs/review_artifacts. The actual saved profile loaded successfully and reproduced byte-for-byte from saved public observations.

The comparison reuses the pinned unchanged fingerprints in both substitution directions. Reports contain fixed schema/field keys and booleans, never metadata values, raw environment, credential hashes or exception text. Both child-side comparison and parent-side ingestion validate the report. Synthetic private-value and malicious-report tests pass.

Installer requests diagnostics only after all non-metadata replacement checks pass, including new ID, expected image, attempt, created/never-started state, restart policy and network IDs. Concrete backend rechecks requested ID/name and owned stopped placeholder eligibility. compare refuses a re-inspection whose selected configured/legacy digest differs from the prior controller snapshot. Snapshot binding is to the existing normalized selected-metadata digest, not every raw inspect field.

review_checks.check: Bounded failure path and rollback authority
review_checks.evidence: Diagnostic invocation uses existing Installer._call with min(60, remaining work budget), preserving the separate 120-second recovery reserve. ProcessExecutor bounds child lifetime and JSON transfer, suppresses child stdout/stderr and exception details, and kills the process group. Diagnostic errors become unavailable evidence. Receipt-write failure escapes to the existing failure/finally rollback path. The unchanged metadata gate still rejects; offline tests confirm diagnostic recording precedes cleanup and no source verification follows metadata failure.

New backend constructor parameter is keyword-only and defaults to None. Absent profile returns unavailable without a diagnostic command; legacy backends lacking the optional method are caught without bypassing rejection. Profile CLI arguments must be paired. Validation-only return still precedes lock, receipt and concrete backend construction; --apply-install does not confer human authorization.

verification.command: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ./.venv/bin/python -B -m pytest -q --noconftest -c /dev/null -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_companion_metadata_diagnostics.py tests/test_companion_installer.py tests/test_companion_network_configuration.py tests/test_companion_stopped_recipe.py

accepted_risks_and_unverified_points.detail: The focused selection is red on the two exact checkpoint-listed recipe failures. No fixtures or legacy sources were repaired. This disposition is not suite-wide acceptance.

The checkpoint records both recipe failures reproduced against preserved pre-change source. This review confirmed the preserved installer/backend hashes and current failure signatures, but did not independently rerun that baseline experiment.

Actual runtime inspect compatibility, concrete timeout behavior for this diagnostic call, operational rollback/restoration, and the field/cause of the consumed attempt's mismatch were not exercised. New installer failure-path tests use an inline fake executor; child timeout containment is supported here by static inspection of the unchanged executor, not a new runtime timeout test.

Diagnostics are best effort. Unsupported metadata or changed selected snapshots may produce available:false. Per-field comparisons follow gate normalization and do not establish root cause; interactions may remain unresolved.

proof_required_next: Parent may preserve diff/proof receipts and update its work log. Any operational step requires fresh bounded human authorization and current code/artifact bindings; this review grants none and cannot revive a consumed attempt. No further proof is required to close this bounded offline review.
